ledger: Parked truck at diner: 00:00 as a white aerodynamic tractor unit, 01:41 as a dark green classic Kenworth straight truck.

findings.description: The only truck parked outside the diner changes entirely between the establishing shot and when the man leaves. At 00:00, it is a modern, white aerodynamic tractor unit. At 01:41, it has become a dark green, classic square-nosed Kenworth straight truck with a box body.
